title: 网络安全 · 身份与数据安全 30 句
description: 覆盖身份生命周期、特权访问、零信任、数据分类、加密、DLP、备份与数据治理的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 新员工权限应根据岗位自动分配，并由直属经理确认任何额外访问。
items.en: Access for a new employee should be assigned according to role, with any additional entitlement confirmed by the line manager.
answers: Access for a new employee should be assigned according to role, with any additional entitlement confirmed by the line manager.
items.notes: according to 表示分配依据；with 独立结构补充额外权限要求。

items.zh: 员工调岗时，旧权限必须与新权限同时复核，以免累积不再需要的访问。
items.en: When an employee changes role, previous access must be reviewed alongside new entitlements to prevent unnecessary privileges from accumulating.
answers: When an employee changes role, previous access must be reviewed alongside new entitlements to prevent unnecessary privileges from accumulating.
items.notes: alongside 表示一并；prevent A from doing 表示防止权限累积。

items.zh: 离职流程依赖人力系统及时发送状态变更，而不是由各应用分别发现。
items.en: The leaver process relies on the human-resources system to provide a timely status change rather than expecting each application to discover the departure separately.
answers: The leaver process relies on the human-resources system to provide a timely status change rather than expecting each application to discover the departure separately.
items.notes: rely on A to do；rather than doing 对比集中触发与分散发现。

items.zh: 长期未使用的账户可能属于休假员工，也可能是未完成撤销的遗留身份。
items.en: A long-dormant account may belong to an employee on leave or represent an identity that was never fully deprovisioned.
answers: A long-dormant account may belong to an employee on leave or represent an identity that was never fully deprovisioned.
items.notes: may A or B 提出两种解释；deprovision 表示撤销账户资源。

items.zh: 服务账户需要明确负责人，即使没有个人每天使用它。
items.en: A service account needs a named owner even though no individual uses it interactively each day.
answers: A service account needs a named owner even though no individual uses it interactively each day.
items.notes: even though 引导让步；named owner 指明确指定的负责人。

items.zh: 最小权限不是一次性项目，因为用户职责和系统功能都会随时间变化。
items.en: Least privilege is not a one-off exercise, because both user responsibilities and system functions change over time.
answers: Least privilege is not a one-off exercise, because both user responsibilities and system functions change over time.
items.notes: one-off exercise 表示一次性工作；both ... and 并列变化因素。

items.zh: 角色包含过多例外时，它就不再代表一组可复用的业务职责。
items.en: When a role contains too many exceptions, it no longer represents a reusable set of business responsibilities.
answers: When a role contains too many exceptions, it no longer represents a reusable set of business responsibilities.
items.notes: when 引出角色失效条件；no longer 表示不再。

items.zh: 权限复核应向审批人展示访问用途，而不能只显示难以理解的技术组名。
items.en: An access review should show the approver what each entitlement permits, not merely an opaque technical group name.
answers: An access review should show the approver what each entitlement permits, not merely an opaque technical group name.
items.notes: 双宾语 show someone what；not merely 强调可理解背景。

items.zh: 如果经理无法判断权限是否合理，就应转交给了解应用的负责人。
items.en: If a manager cannot judge whether access is appropriate, the decision should be referred to an owner who understands the application.
answers: If a manager cannot judge whether access is appropriate, the decision should be referred to an owner who understands the application.
items.notes: whether 引导判断内容；who 引导定语从句限定负责人。

items.zh: 职责分离规则应识别危险的权限组合，而不是把每项权限单独视为高风险。
items.en: Segregation-of-duties rules should identify dangerous combinations of access rather than label each permission as high risk in isolation.
answers: Segregation-of-duties rules should identify dangerous combinations of access rather than label each permission as high risk in isolation.
items.notes: rather than 对比组合风险与单项风险；in isolation 表示孤立。

items.zh: 管理员通过个人账户申请临时提权，使每个高权限操作都能追溯到具体人员。
items.en: Administrators request temporary elevation through their personal accounts so that every privileged action can be traced to an individual.
answers: Administrators request temporary elevation through their personal accounts so that every privileged action can be traced to an individual.
items.notes: so that 表示可追溯目的；trace to 表示追溯到。

items.zh: 紧急账户凭据密封保存，只有正常身份服务不可用时才能取用。
items.en: Credentials for the emergency account are held under seal and may be retrieved only when the normal identity service is unavailable.
answers: Credentials for the emergency account are held under seal and may be retrieved only when the normal identity service is unavailable.
items.notes: under seal 表示密封保管；only when 限定启用条件。

items.zh: 会话记录可以支持调查，但必须限制访问，避免管理员活动被过度监控。
items.en: Session recording can support investigations, but access to the recordings must be restricted to avoid disproportionate monitoring of administrators.
answers: Session recording can support investigations, but access to the recordings must be restricted to avoid disproportionate monitoring of administrators.
items.notes: but 平衡调查需要与隐私；to avoid 说明访问限制目的。

items.zh: 密码库轮换了目标账户密码，却因缓存凭据而没有立即终止现有会话。
items.en: The vault rotated the target account's password, although existing sessions remained active because of cached credentials.
answers: The vault rotated the target account's password, although existing sessions remained active because of cached credentials.
items.notes: although 引出轮换局限；because of 后接名词短语说明原因。

items.zh: 高权限命令需要二次审批，不代表审批人可以忽略操作发生的业务背景。
items.en: Requiring secondary approval for a privileged command does not remove the approver's need to understand its business context.
answers: Requiring secondary approval for a privileged command does not remove the approver's need to understand its business context.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；does not remove 表示控制不替代判断。

items.zh: 零信任策略根据身份、设备状态和请求背景持续判断访问，而不只依赖网络位置。
items.en: A zero-trust policy evaluates access continuously according to identity, device posture, and request context rather than relying solely on network location.
answers: A zero-trust policy evaluates access continuously according to identity, device posture, and request context rather than relying solely on network location.
items.notes: according to 列出动态信号；rather than doing 对比传统边界。

items.zh: 设备曾经合规并不能保证它在整个会话期间保持安全状态。
items.en: A device being compliant at sign-in does not guarantee that it remains secure throughout the session.
answers: A device being compliant at sign-in does not guarantee that it remains secure throughout the session.
items.notes: does not guarantee that 限制时点检查结论；throughout 表示整个期间。

items.zh: 条件访问拒绝来自高风险位置的登录，同时允许经过强化验证的业务例外。
items.en: Conditional access blocks sign-ins from high-risk locations while allowing approved business exceptions with stronger verification.
answers: Conditional access blocks sign-ins from high-risk locations while allowing approved business exceptions with stronger verification.
items.notes: while doing 表示控制与例外并存；with 引出强化条件。

items.zh: 微隔离限制单个身份被攻陷后的可达范围，从而缩小潜在影响。
items.en: Micro-segmentation limits what a compromised identity can reach, thereby reducing the potential blast radius.
answers: Micro-segmentation limits what a compromised identity can reach, thereby reducing the potential blast radius.
items.notes: what 引导宾语从句；thereby doing 说明降低影响结果。

items.zh: 访问决定失败时默认拒绝，除非业务已经明确接受降级模式的风险。
items.en: An access decision fails closed unless the business has explicitly accepted the risk of a degraded mode.
answers: An access decision fails closed unless the business has explicitly accepted the risk of a degraded mode.
items.notes: fail closed 指失败时拒绝；unless 引出经批准的例外。

items.zh: 数据分类应反映泄露、篡改或不可用可能造成的业务影响。
items.en: Data classification should reflect the business impact that disclosure, alteration, or unavailability could cause.
answers: Data classification should reflect the business impact that disclosure, alteration, or unavailability could cause.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；三个并列名词覆盖机密性、完整性和可用性。

items.zh: 同一文件包含不同敏感度的信息时，应按其中最高要求实施保护。
items.en: Where a file contains information at different sensitivity levels, it should be protected according to the highest applicable requirement.
answers: Where a file contains information at different sensitivity levels, it should be protected according to the highest applicable requirement.
items.notes: where 引出混合数据情境；according to 表示保护依据。

items.zh: 标签只有在下游系统据此采取一致控制时，才真正具备治理价值。
items.en: A label has governance value only when downstream systems apply consistent controls on the basis of it.
answers: A label has governance value only when downstream systems apply consistent controls on the basis of it.
items.notes: only when 限定标签价值；on the basis of 表示以标签为依据。

items.zh: 数据所有者决定谁可以访问，而平台团队负责可靠实施这一决定。
items.en: The data owner decides who may have access, while the platform team is responsible for enforcing that decision reliably.
answers: The data owner decides who may have access, while the platform team is responsible for enforcing that decision reliably.
items.notes: who 引导宾语从句；while 划分决策与执行职责。

items.zh: 发现未分类数据后，应先确定其业务用途，再决定保留、保护或删除。
items.en: When unclassified data is discovered, its business purpose should be established before a decision is made to retain, protect, or delete it.
answers: When unclassified data is discovered, its business purpose should be established before a decision is made to retain, protect, or delete it.
items.notes: before 强调治理顺序；三个不定式并列表示处置选择。

items.zh: 静态加密保护存储介质，却无法阻止已获授权的应用读取明文。
items.en: Encryption at rest protects the storage medium, but it cannot prevent an authorised application from reading the plaintext.
answers: Encryption at rest protects the storage medium, but it cannot prevent an authorised application from reading the plaintext.
items.notes: prevent A from doing；but 限定静态加密能力。

items.zh: 密钥与加密数据分开管理，能够降低单个存储位置泄露造成的风险。
items.en: Managing keys separately from encrypted data reduces the risk arising from compromise of a single storage location.
answers: Managing keys separately from encrypted data reduces the risk arising from compromise of a single storage location.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；arising from 作后置定语说明风险来源。

items.zh: 数据防泄漏规则先以监控模式运行，以了解正常传输并避免阻断关键流程。
items.en: The data-loss prevention rule runs in monitoring mode first to understand legitimate transfers and avoid blocking a critical process.
answers: The data-loss prevention rule runs in monitoring mode first to understand legitimate transfers and avoid blocking a critical process.
items.notes: to understand 与 avoid 并列表示试运行的两个目的。

items.zh: 备份不可变性能阻止攻击者删除恢复点，但仍需测试数据能否按时恢复。
items.en: Backup immutability can prevent an attacker from deleting recovery points, but the organisation must still test whether data can be restored on time.
answers: Backup immutability can prevent an attacker from deleting recovery points, but the organisation must still test whether data can be restored on time.
items.notes: prevent A from doing；whether 引导恢复测试内容。

items.zh: 删除请求完成后，系统还应说明数据是否因法律保留而存在于受限归档中。
items.en: After a deletion request is fulfilled, the system should state whether any data remains in a restricted archive under a legal hold.
answers: After a deletion request is fulfilled, the system should state whether any data remains in a restricted archive under a legal hold.
items.notes: whether 引导剩余数据说明；under a legal hold 是法律保留表达。
